document_meta.owner: AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) + Strategy Team
document_meta.notes: This JSON encodes the evaluation rules, rubrics, gates, escalations, auto-adjustments, caps, tiering, and governance requirements used to score and route AI initiatives.

priority_score_model.score_scale: 1-5 per parameter (unless otherwise stated); overall Priority Score is weighted average

human_validation_requirements.tier3: Mandatory full committee review of scoring
human_validation_requirements.tier2: Review by at least two AI CoE senior members
human_validation_requirements.near_boundary_manual_review: Any initiative within 0.3 points of a tier boundary must be manually reviewed
human_validation_requirements.calibration: Quarterly calibration sessions by the Review Committee

mandatory_escalation.description: If any trigger matches, initiative is forced to Tier 3 regardless of Priority Score.
mandatory_escalation.routing: Escalated initiatives bypass standard tier routing and proceed directly to Governance Committee

scale.label: Transformational
scale.definition: Advances multiple core strategic priorities simultaneously; strong alignment with vision, ASD, HEART; creates competitive differentiation; measurable contribution to strategic targets.

scale.label: Multiple Priorities
scale.definition: Directly advances at least one core priority with strong alignment across two or more strategic elements; positive social impact or strong financial returns.

scale.label: Primary Pillar
scale.definition: Supports one strategic pillar; indirect support to priorities; reasonable business case but not strategic imperative.

scale.label: Secondary Objective
scale.definition: Tangential to strategy; primarily operational or compliance-driven; limited strategic alignment.

scale.label: Tangential
scale.definition: No clear strategic benefit; not aligned with stated strategy.

vision_alignment.description: Contribution to Sterling's vision: technological capability, customer-centric business model, competitive differentiation.

rules.condition: Claims customer-centricity but adds friction to customer experience
Enhances technology but does not serve a strategic business outcome

scale.criteria: Directly advances all three vision elements; explicitly derived from strategic documents; Group Head endorsement as strategic priority.
Advances two of three vision elements; clear line-of-sight to market share/customer base/ROAE targets.
Advances one vision element meaningfully; enables rather than directly delivers outcomes.
Tangential; operational/tactical benefit; no link to differentiation/customer-centricity.
No vision alignment; pure cost-reduction/compliance with no differentiation.

asd_framework_alignment.description: Score Agility, Specialization, Digitization independently (1–5), then average.

score_5_indicators: Reusable capabilities across multiple use cases
score_3_indicators: Improves flexibility in a single process/department
Improves understanding of a specific segment/sector
Digitizes manual process with measurable gain
score_1_indicators: Adds digital layer without removing manual processes

rules.condition: Explicitly designed as ASD framework implementation

heart_sector_impact.description: Mandatory HEART classification; sector scoring informs Strategic Alignment.

health.score5: Finances healthcare infrastructure at scale (>100 providers or >₦500M) or platform enabling access for underserved or reduces delivery costs >30%
health.score3: Supports healthcare ops/efficiency; enables financing but not primary purpose

education.score5: Finances education infrastructure at scale (>100 schools or >₦500M) or platform enabling access for underserved or increases enrollment >10,000 students
education.score3: Supports education ops; builds sector expertise

agriculture.score5: Finances ag value chain at scale (>1,000 farmers or >₦500M) or platform linking value chain actors
agriculture.score3: Supports ag ops; enables financing but not primary purpose

renewable_energy.score5: Creates RE trading platform (>50 participants) or finances RE projects (>10,000 users) or reduces power costs >30% or attracts foreign investment >₦1B
renewable_energy.score3: Supports RE ops; builds sector expertise

transportation.score5: Creates payment platform (>1,000 operators) or finances mass transit infrastructure or scales transport businesses (>100 operators)
transportation.score3: Supports transport ops; builds sector expertise

rules.condition: Directly contributes to 60% HEART portfolio target
Moves portfolio away from HEART concentration target

business_segment_alignment.scoring_guidance: Score 5 for Tier 1 at scale (>100K customers or >₦500M). Score 4 for Tier 1 meaningful or Tier 2 at scale. Score 3 for Tier 2 meaningful or Tier 3 at scale. Score 2 for Tier 3 or indirect Tier 1–2. Score 1 for no defined strategic segment.

500_for_50_in_5.description: Automatic score 5 if directly enables identifying/mentoring/incubating/financing Nigerian businesses for global scale or creates platform connecting Sterling 500 businesses to resources.
500_for_50_in_5.rule_if_both_heart_and_500: Add +0.5 if serves both a HEART sector and '500 for 50 in 5'.

social_capitalism_impact.description: Impact + Risk + Revenue = Business. Each initiative must show social/environmental impact AND financial returns.

scale.label: Transformational
scale.criteria: Addresses critical social/environmental need at scale (>100K people) with measurable impact and profitable sustainability.

scale.label: Strong
scale.criteria: Significant need addressed (>10K people) with clear social benefit and financial returns.

scale.label: Moderate
scale.criteria: Some benefit (>1K people); financial returns prioritized but social benefit exists.

scale.label: None
scale.criteria: Purely profit-driven; no social consideration; could harm community/environment.

rules.condition: Serves a social need but business model unsustainable

stakeholder_value.scoring: Score 5 for measurable value to all five; 4 for 3–4; 3 for 2; 2 for 1; 1 for none.

rules.condition: Benefits one stakeholder at the expense of another

scale.criteria: New business line/market; Nigeria-first/Africa-first; competitive moat; potential >₦1B annually within 3 years.
Major enhancement creating advantage; novel combination; first-in-sector for Sterling.

penalties.condition: 7–8 of 9 addressed
5–6 of 9 addressed
Fewer than 5 addressed

adjustments.condition: Point solution designed for platform migration

scale.definition: Critical regulatory mandate or eliminates severe compliance risk; non-compliance risks significant penalties/licence/systemic exposure.
High-risk exposure or major regulatory obligation; failure materially increases risk profile.
Significant compliance requirement or meaningful exposure; prudent risk management.
Moderate-risk requirement; important but not urgent.

risk_coverage_assessment.scoring: Score 5 if all three addressed; 4 for two; 3 for one; 2 for risk-neutral; 1 if increases risk without mitigation (also triggers Tier 3 escalation).

regulatory_risk.risk_ethos_alignment_rule: Absent/inadequate risk assessment, opaque structures, or risk disproportionate to return => max score 2.

platform_adjustments.condition: Directly drives platform growth toward target or creates a new strategic platform with >₦100M year-one impact
Supports platform operations or enables platform indirectly

scale_by_timeline_months.characteristics: Low complexity; straightforward; proven approaches; minimal dependencies.

scale.profile: Minimal resources; existing capacity and infrastructure sufficient.
Light resources; small team; minimal infrastructure additions.
Moderate resources; part-time team; moderate infrastructure.
Significant resources; dedicated team; substantial infrastructure.
Extensive resources; large dedicated team; major infrastructure investment.

pillars.name: Awareness and Governance
pillars.passing_rule: All satisfied => proceed; 3–4 => conditional with remediation plan; <3 => reject until addressed

pillars.name: Change Management
requirements: Consult AI Central Governance Team (Strategy, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Human Capital, Engineering)

pillars.name: People Development
requirements: Capacity development plan with capstone projects

Direct contribution to the '500 for 50 in 5' programme
Creates a platform serving multiple HEART sectors
Endorsed by Managing Director as strategic priority
Ecosystem effect: multiple digital platforms working together
True platform: reusable capability across multiple use cases
Creates value for all five stakeholder groups
Builds AI maturity in a dimension currently scoring below 3/5
Enables partner/vendor ecosystem with network effects
Directly contributes to 60% HEART portfolio target
Builds AI capability in the workforce
Point solution designed for future platform migration

penalties.condition: Creates customer friction in Tier 1 strategic segments
Violates Sterling's behavioural code (especially ethical standards)
Displaces employees without a reskilling plan
Contradicts social capitalism philosophy (profit without social benefit)
Moves portfolio away from HEART sector concentration target
No change management plan for a workforce-impacting AI initiative
Benefits one stakeholder group at expense of another
Significantly increases Sterling's carbon footprint
Point solution when platform approach is available
Creates standalone silo contradicting platform strategy
Increases customer friction measurably
Technology architecture compliance below 5 of 9 attributes
Physical-only solution when digital is appropriate
Architecture compliance 7–8 of 9 attributes
Generic solution with no specialization
Competes head-on with Tier 1 banks on their terms

hard_score_caps.condition: No HEART sector relevance AND no significant social impact
Serves a non-strategic customer segment exclusively
AI initiative not aligned with AI Adoption Framework
Social benefit exists but business model is unsustainable
Benefits one stakeholder at the expense of another
Purely compliance-driven with no strategic benefit
Claims customer-centricity but adds friction to experience
Enhances technology without strategic business outcome

bands.decision: Conditional approval; consider deferring if resource-constrained.
Defer or request resubmission with stronger rationale.

highest: HEART sector impact (esp. if behind 60% target)

edge_cases.scenario: High financial impact, low strategic alignment
edge_cases.guidance: May proceed on Business Impact but must not distract from strategic priorities; expected overall score ~2.5–3.5.
Score strategy highly (4.0–5.0); low Implementation Complexity will lower overall; require robust risk plan.
Score on genuine strategic benefit. If measurable: 3.0–4.0; if tangential: 2.0–2.5.
Assess against spirit of strategy; flag for strategic discussion; consider Tier 3 escalation.

documentation_requirements: Rationale for each section score with initiative-specific examples
All bonuses and penalties applied with justification
post_approval_tracking_12_month_review_q: Did the initiative achieve projected strategic impact?
What lessons can improve future scoring?

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: AI Governance Checklist
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: All AI/ML initiatives must satisfy an 8-item governance checklist: (1) alignment with AI Governance Document, (2) AI Central Governance Team consulted, (3) change management plan included, (4) data readiness verified, (5) ethical considerations addressed, (6) human oversight defined, (7) bias and fairness assessed, (8) transparency and explainability addressed. All 8 items = proceed. 6–7 items = conditional approval with remediation. Fewer than 6 = reject.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Group Head Pre-Approval
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Every initiative must have documented Group Head approval before submission to the AI CoE. Submissions without this approval are returned without screening.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: HEART Sector Classification
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Every initiative must be classified at submission as Direct HEART Impact, Indirect HEART Impact, HEART-Adjacent, or Non-HEART. Submissions without classification are returned as incomplete.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Minimum Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives with a calculated Priority Score below 1.5 are rejected with detailed feedback and improvement recommendations. Initiatives scoring 1.5–2.0 may proceed only with enhanced oversight.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Data Readiness Gate (AI/ML)
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: For AI/ML initiatives, four data conditions must be met: required data available and accessible, data quality sufficient, data governance and privacy addressed, data pipeline sustainable. All 4 = proceed. 2–3 = conditional with remediation. Fewer than 2 = reject.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Architecture Compliance Minimum
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: All initiatives must address nine architecture attributes: Modularity, Availability, Interoperability, Maintainability, Performance, Scalability, Security, Usability, Suitability. Fewer than 5 attributes addressed triggers automatic Tier 3 escalation for architecture review.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY GATES — Pass/fail checks that must be satisfied before an initiative can proceed
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: AI Framework Alignment Gate
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: AI initiatives not aligned with Sterling's 4-pillar AI Adoption Framework (Awareness & Governance, Change Management, People Development, AI-Driven Solutions) are capped at a maximum Strategic Alignment score of 2 and cannot exceed Tier 2.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: HR/Employment Decision AI
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Any AI system involved in recruitment screening, candidate selection, performance evaluation, promotion recommendations, termination decisions, or compensation determination automatically escalates to Tier 3 regardless of Priority Score.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Automated Customer Decisions
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Any AI that makes credit approval/denial, insurance underwriting/claims, account closure/denial, or pricing/terms decisions without human review automatically escalates to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Sensitive Data Processing
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives processing biometric data (facial recognition, fingerprints, voice), health/medical information, children's data, or aggregated sensitive financial data beyond standard banking automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: High Brand/Reputational Risk
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Public-facing AI systems with high brand visibility, systems processing data for vulnerable populations, novel AI without industry precedent, and cross-border data transfers to high-risk jurisdictions automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Strategic Magnitude — Investment
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives with total investment exceeding ₦1 billion or projected annual impact exceeding ₦500 million automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Strategic Magnitude — Market Position
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives that could move Sterling from Tier 2 to Tier 1 market positioning, create a new business line, or represent major market entry automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Strategic Magnitude — Scale
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Platforms expected to serve more than 1 million customers or more than 1,000 businesses automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Custom LLM / AI Infrastructure
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Any initiative building a Custom LLM, AI Database, or core internal AI infrastructure automatically escalates to Tier 3 as a strategic AI project.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: HEART Portfolio Shift
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives that would significantly change the HEART sector portfolio mix (either toward or away from the 60% target) automatically escalate to Tier 3 for strategic portfolio review.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Foreign/Impact Partnership
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives involving strategic partnerships with major impact investors, foreign entities, or cross-border arrangements with data sovereignty implications automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: MANDATORY ESCALATION TRIGGERS — Conditions that force automatic Tier 3 escalation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Vulnerable Populations
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiatives targeting vulnerable populations (elderly, children, financially distressed) without documented special safeguards automatically escalate to Tier 3.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: SCORING PARAMETERS — The six weighted parameters in the Priority Score formula
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Strategic Alignment
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Weight: 25% of Priority Score. Measures alignment with Sterling's vision (technological capability, customer-centricity, competitive differentiation), ASD framework (Agility, Specialization, Digitization), HEART sector priorities, social capitalism philosophy, and competitive positioning. Score 1 = tangential to strategy. Score 3 = supports a primary strategic pillar. Score 5 = transformational, advances multiple priorities and creates competitive differentiation.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: SCORING PARAMETERS — The six weighted parameters in the Priority Score formula
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Regulatory Risk
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Weight: 25% of Priority Score. Measures the severity of the compliance need the initiative addresses. Score 1 = low-risk gap or minor regulatory enhancement. Score 3 = significant compliance requirement or meaningful risk exposure. Score 5 = critical regulatory mandate; non-compliance would cause penalties, licence risk, or systemic exposure.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: SCORING PARAMETERS — The six weighted parameters in the Priority Score formula
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Business Impact
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Weight: 20% of Priority Score. Measures expected annual value creation. Score 1 = below ₦50M. Score 2 = ₦50M–₦150M. Score 3 = ₦150M–₦300M. Score 4 = ₦300M–₦500M. Score 5 = above ₦500M or transformational impact on the business model.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: SCORING PARAMETERS — The six weighted parameters in the Priority Score formula
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Implementation Complexity
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Weight: 15% of Priority Score. Higher scores mean easier implementation. Score 1 = extremely complex, >12 months, major barriers. Score 3 = moderate, 6–9 months, manageable. Score 5 = low complexity, <3 months, straightforward with proven approaches.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: SCORING PARAMETERS — The six weighted parameters in the Priority Score formula
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Time-to-Value
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Weight: 10% of Priority Score. Measures speed to measurable benefits. Score 1 = >18 months. Score 2 = 12–18 months. Score 3 = 6–12 months. Score 4 = 3–6 months. Score 5 = <3 months.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: SCORING PARAMETERS — The six weighted parameters in the Priority Score formula
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Resource Requirements
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Weight: 5% of Priority Score. Higher scores mean lower resource demands. Score 1 = extensive (large dedicated team, major infrastructure). Score 3 = moderate (part-time team, moderate infrastructure). Score 5 = minimal (existing team and infrastructure sufficient).

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Vision Alignment
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Evaluate contribution to Sterling's three-part vision: enhancing technological capability, entrenching customer-centric business model, and creating competitive differentiation. Score 5 = all three elements advanced with Group Head endorsement. Score 3 = one element advanced meaningfully. Score 1 = does not align.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: ASD — Agility
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess whether the initiative builds adaptive, self-correcting capability. Score 5 = adapts to market changes, enables rapid iteration, reduces time-to-market >30%, builds reusable capabilities. Score 3 = improves flexibility in a single process. Score 1 = rigid single-purpose solution.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: ASD — Specialization
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess whether the initiative builds deep sector expertise. Score 5 = proprietary HEART sector knowledge competitors cannot replicate, sector-specific solutions better than generic. Score 3 = some differentiated capability. Score 1 = generic commodity solution.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: ASD — Digitization
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess whether the initiative enables technology-driven efficiency and scale. Score 5 = transforms experience across multiple touchpoints, >50% efficiency improvement, scales without linear cost. Score 3 = digitizes one manual process. Score 1 = technology for its own sake.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: HEART Sector Impact
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess direct impact on Health, Education, Agriculture, Renewable Energy, and/or Transportation sectors. Score 5 = finances or enables HEART sector at scale (see sector-specific thresholds). Score 3 = supports sector operations. Score 1 = no HEART relevance. If all five sectors served, automatic Score 5.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Business Segment Fit
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Evaluate which customer tier is served. Tier 1 (highest priority): Individual Banking, Micro Banking, Alternative Finance, SME. Tier 2: Government/Institutional, Commercial. Tier 3: Large Corporate. Score 5 = Tier 1 at scale (>100K customers or >₦500M). Score 1 = no defined strategic segment.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: 500 for 50 in 5 Alignment
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess contribution to Sterling's programme to build 500 Nigerian businesses into 50 globally acceptable enterprises in 5 years. Automatic Score 5 if initiative directly enables identification, mentoring, incubation, or financing for global scale.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Social Capitalism Impact
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Sterling's formula: Impact + Risk + Revenue = Business. Score 5 = addresses critical social/environmental need at scale (>100K people), measurable impact on poverty/inclusion/sustainability, and profitable. Score 3 = some benefit (>1K people) with returns prioritized. Score 1 = purely profit-driven, no social consideration.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Stakeholder Value Breadth
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Evaluate value creation across five groups: Customers, Employees, Shareholders, Regulators, Community/Vendors. Score 5 = measurable value to all five. Score 3 = two groups. Score 1 = benefits Sterling alone.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Financial Metrics Contribution
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess contribution to primary targets: 5% market share, 5M retail customers, ROAE above peers, NPL below peers, double-digit revenue growth, cost of funds <5%, top-quartile diversified income. Score 5 = contributes to 3+ metrics. Score 3 = 1 metric. Score 1 = no financial contribution.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Innovation Classification
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Classify as Transformative (new markets, disrupts industry, Nigeria-first capability, potential >₦1B/year in 3 years) or Incremental (optimizes existing processes). Score 5 = transformative with competitive moat. Score 3 = meaningful improvement adopting proven innovation. Score 1 = business-as-usual.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Digital Pillar Alignment
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Assess fit with three IT pillars: Digital Experiences (customer touchpoints), Digital Business (cloud, APIs, automation), Digital Workplace (collaboration, data access). Average scores across applicable pillars. All three addressed = automatic Score 5. Zero addressed = max score 2.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: AI Maturity Contribution
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Current maturity gaps: Regulatory & Ethical (2/5), Scalability (2/5), Infrastructure (2/5). Score 5 = improves 3+ dimensions. Score 3 = improves 1 dimension. Score 1 = adds complexity without capability gain.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Competitive Differentiation
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Score 5 = creates capability competitors cannot replicate, first-mover in high-value market. Score 3 = closes competitive gaps using best practices. Score 1 = no differentiation, commodity offering.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT SUB-ASSESSMENTS — Sub-dimensions evaluated during comprehensive analysis
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Environmental Sustainability
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Score 5 = reduces carbon >1,000 tons/year, finances renewable energy at scale, promotes mass transit. Score 3 = some benefit (paper reduction, efficiency). Score 1 = increases emissions or finances harmful activities.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: 5-Year Strategy Mention
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative is explicitly mentioned in or directly derived from Sterling's 5-Year Strategy Document.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: MD Strategic Endorsement
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative has been formally endorsed by the Managing Director as a strategic priority.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Multi-HEART Platform
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative creates a platform serving multiple HEART sectors simultaneously, advancing the 60% portfolio target across sector lines.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: 500 for 50 in 5 Contribution
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative directly enables the identification, mentoring, incubation, or financing of Nigerian businesses within the "500 for 50 in 5" programme.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Platform Ecosystem Effect
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative creates an ecosystem where multiple Sterling digital platforms (Specta, Altmall, OnePay, etc.) work together, generating compounding value.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Reusable Platform Capability
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative creates a true platform: reusable across multiple use cases, API-first, scales without linear cost, creates network effects, supports partner ecosystem (5 of 5 characteristics).

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Bottom-of-Pyramid Focus
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative serves low-income or financially excluded populations at scale, advancing financial inclusion and Sterling's social capitalism mission.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Environmental Impact
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative delivers measurable environmental sustainability benefits: carbon reduction, clean energy promotion, or mass transit adoption.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: All-Stakeholder Value
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative creates measurable value for all five stakeholder groups (Customers, Employees, Shareholders, Regulators, Community/Vendors).

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Multi-Platform Integration
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative integrates two or more existing Sterling digital platforms, creating cross-platform synergies.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: AI Maturity Builder
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative directly improves one or more AI maturity dimensions currently scoring below 3/5 (Regulatory & Ethical, Scalability, Infrastructure).

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: HEART Portfolio Contribution
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative directly contributes to achieving the 60% HEART sector risk asset target.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.name: Comprehensive Change Management
atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: Initiative includes a full change management plan following Sterling's three-phase framework (Preparing, Managing, Reinforcing) with all governance teams consulted.

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.section: AUTOMATIC SCORE BOOSTS — Conditions that increase the Priority Score

atomic_rules_from_spreadsheet.description: If the initiative does not align with any of the three ASD pillars (Agility, Specialization, Digitization), the Strategic Alignment score is capped at 2.0.
